# 0046: Separate document sufficiency from length targets

Status: accepted
Type: domain
Date: 2026-10-24

## Context

0045's headless-failure revisit trigger fired. The first freeform cell used its
one bounded repair, covered all eight required facts in86 words, passed eight
configured model support reviews, and held against its frozen100-word minimum.
The original study remains failed. Goals are unassessed; usefulness and audience
adaptation are not established by factual support or source-like wording.
[Retained evidence](../../evidence/prose-headless/2026-10-24-document/README.md).

## Decision

For the next versioned study, treat length as a typed required/advisory goal using
the existing profile and Assignment owners. Default length targets are advisory.
A mandatory range needs a named criterion, consumer reason, independent expected
scope and pre-dispatch acceptance. Report actual words and every deviation.
Required source, support, disclosure, authority, coverage and resource floors stay
mandatory. A length warning cannot bypass independent sufficiency, decision-useful
content, clarity or audience review. Resource limits remain hard regardless of
presentation goals. No new universal prose-quality score or length engine.

Keep a separate required long-artifact case to prove long-document behavior and
limits. Shortening a fixture cannot satisfy that capability. Six-type/two-audience/
three-repeat completeness, >=30 first accepts, all36 within one bounded repair and
zero critical false publication remain HP requirements for a newly frozen study.

Do not relabel the old cell or continue its exhausted repair. A prospective policy
revision and any offline reassessment have distinct identities/results. Replayed
captured output is not a new independent sample. All prior failed/uncertain spend,
missing cells and repairs remain in their original denominator and stage accounting.

## Alternatives rejected

- Universal hard minimum words: rewards padding instead of useful completeness.
  Wins if: a named format or a separate stress case requires it, with prior rationale.
- Relax the frozen gate and report a pass: would rewrite failed evidence.
  Wins if: never.
- Remove the long-output case: hides an important capability gap.
  Wins if: the owner explicitly removes long-document support from the scope.
- Factual-model support alone means ready: purpose/coverage/clarity can still fail.
  Wins if: never.

## Delivery and remaining proof

HP-10 adds an explicitly versioned, experimental command-local intake with a
separately pinned goal scope, required long witness and canonical per-goal fitness
assessments. The v1 path retains its original hard range. The
[offline qualification](../../evidence/prose-headless/2026-10-25-length/README.md)
is policy/shape evidence, not independent document quality or a completed live study.
No additional paid retry, acceptance upgrade, publication or UI entry follows.

## Revisit when

A mandatory consumer range is waived, advisory length hides a sufficiency failure,
the separate long-artifact case is omitted, a failed sample is relabeled, or the
next study/release/2026-11-21 arrives. Retain0045's budget and incubation boundaries.
